concepts.plainMeaning: Locking in a guaranteed riskless profit when two equivalent portfolios trade at different prices.
concepts.roleHere: Core replication force guaranteeing exact forward pricing equality.
concepts.analogy: Buying an identical smartphone at one store for less and selling it instantly next door for more.

concepts.plainMeaning: An asset held by investors mainly for financial return rather than industrial consumption.
concepts.roleHere: Distinguishes assets where two-sided forward equality holds tightly.
concepts.analogy: Gold bullion stored in bank vaults solely for wealth preservation.

concepts.plainMeaning: A commodity held primarily to be consumed or processed by businesses.
concepts.roleHere: Explains why short-sale limits enforce only an upper price ceiling.
concepts.analogy: Crude oil sitting in refinery tanks to keep jet fuel production running.

concepts.plainMeaning: Borrowing shares to sell immediately at spot price and buying them back later to return.
concepts.roleHere: Mechanism enabling traders to enforce the lower forward price bound.
concepts.analogy: Borrowing a friend's camera to sell while prices are high, then replacing it later at a lower price.

concepts.plainMeaning: Borrowing cash, buying the spot asset, and shorting an overpriced forward contract.
concepts.roleHere: Trade that pulls overpriced market forwards down to fair value.
concepts.analogy: Financing inventory with a low bank loan after already locking a higher guaranteed buyer price.

concepts.plainMeaning: Short selling the spot asset, investing the cash proceeds, and buying an underpriced forward.
concepts.roleHere: Trade that pushes underpriced forwards back up to equilibrium.
concepts.analogy: Selling borrowed stock for cash interest and locking a cheap repurchase ticket.

concepts.plainMeaning: A steady annualized payout stream that reduces net financing cost to r minus q.
concepts.roleHere: Extends discrete dividend adjustments to multi-stock equity portfolios.
concepts.analogy: A rental property generating continuous monthly income while you pay mortgage interest.

concepts.plainMeaning: The fixed delivery price K written into an existing forward contract at inception.
concepts.roleHere: Remains constant while market quote F0 and paper value f fluctuate.
concepts.analogy: The locked price written on a signed purchase contract months ago.

concepts.plainMeaning: The current mark-to-market worth f of holding an existing forward position today.
concepts.roleHere: Distinguishes paper contract worth from quoted forward delivery price.
concepts.analogy: The resale profit on a locked ticket whose market price has moved above your purchase price.
